purpose: Grid of third-party dark basemap tiles (256px, zoom 12) centred on a fixed lat/lon, with a mandatory credit label. 7x5 tiles in the hero laptop, 3x4 in the phone, 3x3 inside the use-cases map answer.

attribution.description: Credit label visible; fades out (300ms) once the dashboard phase starts.

licensing: Tiles are third-party CARTO/OpenStreetMap data. Credit '© CARTO © OpenStreetMap' must stay visible. CARTO's free basemap tier is non-commercial; see assets/asset-roles.json.
